messages:
harper_sales: Heads-up 10x bank wants EU+UK-only POC. Must have BYO-HSM, EU+UK subprocessors list, and contract wording that inference logs dont leave region. Any hard blockers?
dan_se: Not a blocker but perf profile? chat vs embeddings?\harper_sales: Mostly short chat (avg 80 tokens), bursts to ~150qps; nightly embeddings job ~30k vectors. p95 target ~300ms.
rachel_security: BYO-HSM only for Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can do envelope keys only. Will need dataprotection sign-off for UK. Can provide SOC2 + DPIA extracts.
igor_ops: Subprocessors: aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-west-2, gcp-europe-west1, azure-northeurope, fastcdn-ie. I'll export CSV to ticket PRESALES-3001.
redwood-bot: Created PRESALES-3001. Link: https://internal/presales/PRESALES-3001
nina_ae: Procurement wants sample appendix text and a routing policy snippet for their network team.
dan_se: Snippet (presales):
```
routing:
  tenant: 10x-bank
  data_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-west-2]
  control_plane: dedicated-eu-uk  # requires purchase
  kms: byo-hsm
  telemetry: minimal
```
rachel_security: Draft appendix: "Redwood will process and store inference logs and model artifacts only in Customer-specified EU/UK regions. Control-plane telemetry may be restricted by mutual agreement when a Dedicated or Private control-plane is procured." Will refine with legal.
harper_sales: Action items: igor attach subprocessors + ops playbook (today), rachel draft legal appendix (tomorrow EOD), dan produce perf/cost for 150qps bursts (tomorrow). I'll update customer after we have the appendix and cost. :handshake:
